clue.text: US claim settlement in Oklahoma, say

indicators.note: a settlement is an arrangement reached, so the letters of the preceding words are arranged anew

explanation.surface: An American land claim is being settled in the state of Oklahoma.
explanation.walkthrough: 'settlement' rearranges the letters of US CLAIM. Oklahoma! is the Rodgers and Hammerstein stage show, and 'say' marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Oklahoma! is a famous Broadway stage show with songs, an example of the genre.

clue.text: Club with a bit of spice

definitions.meaning: a heavy staff or ceremonial club
the spice ground from the outer covering of the nutmeg

explanation.surface: A cudgel flavoured with a pinch of seasoning.
explanation.definitionFit: A mace is both a spiked club and a spice made from nutmeg husk.

clue.text: He's QC material

parts.note: a barrister promoted to Queen's Counsel is said to 'take' this fabric, and the counsel himself is called by its name

explanation.surface: A barrister is the sort of person fit to become a senior advocate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'material' reads as 'suitable candidate', but it means fabric: QCs wear gowns of this cloth, and a QC is informally called one.
explanation.definitionFit: Queen's Counsel wear gowns of this fabric, so the fabric names both the cloth and the lawyer.

clue.text: Being calm, scored

definitions.meaning: self-possessed, unruffled
written as music, like a symphony

explanation.surface: Staying cool while putting goals on the board.
explanation.definitionFit: Composed means calm and collected, and also written, as music is composed or scored.

clue.text: Alter formation? Not yet

indicators.note: a new formation of the word alter, its letters arranged differently

explanation.surface: Asked whether to change the line-up, someone answers that it is too soon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'formation' rearranges ALTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done afterwards rather than now is not done yet but in time to come.

clue.text: Believe one side of the account

definitions.meaning: to give credence to, accept as true
in bookkeeping the column opposite debit

explanation.surface: Trust only one party's version of what happened.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit a story is to believe it, and in a ledger the credit side faces the debit side.

clue.text: Split nearly all the income from property

parts.note: a split or tear is a rent

indicators.note: nearly a whole word means it is cut short by its final letter

explanation.surface: Dividing up almost all the money a building brings in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Split' looks like a verb, but here it is a noun meaning a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: Payments received from tenants letting a property are rental income.

clue.text: Flirtations lead to many marriages

indicators.note: the first piece leads, coming in front of the next

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a crossword sense of many
marriages are alliances between families

explanation.surface: Light-hearted romances end up producing plenty of weddings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'many' as a Roman numeral is a convention: D is 500.
explanation.definitionFit: Dalliances are casual romantic affairs, synonyms of flirtations.

clue.text: Anxious period during trial

definitions.meaning: a stressful phase of life
while a case is being heard in court, when the defendant is being tried

explanation.surface: Waiting nervously while the court case goes on.
explanation.definitionFit: A trying time is a difficult spell, and literally the time a case is being tried in court.

clue.text: A strike in the financial centre spells disaster

indicators.note: one piece placed inside the other

parts.note: the City is London's financial district
to lam is to hit or thrash

explanation.surface: A walkout in the banking district would be ruinous.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's banking district; 'strike' suggests a walkout but means a blow.
explanation.definitionFit: A calamity is a catastrophe, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Not out of touch, but performing publicly?

definitions.meaning: in ball games, a ball still live and not over the touchline
appearing in a stage production

explanation.surface: Someone still up to date is also appearing on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: Touch is the area beyond the sidelines in rugby and football; a ball not in touch is live.
explanation.definitionFit: A live ball not in touch is in play, and an actor in a play is performing publicly.

clue.text: Brush off and polish again

definitions.meaning: snub, reject
re- plus buff, to shine once more

explanation.surface: Dusting something down and shining it up a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuff is to snub, and read as re-buff it means to polish a second time.

clue.text: The family's failure makes a wretched story

parts.note: poor means pitiable or miserable
a relation is an account or narrative

explanation.surface: The black sheep of the family makes for a sorry tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A poor relation is the least successful member of a family, or of a group.

clue.text: Quiet, shy chap to turn into a violent one

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: the letters of the preceding words are turned into something new

explanation.surface: A quiet, bashful man may become dangerously aggressive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn into' rearranges SHY CHAP TO, after P for quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: A psychopath is a person with a dangerous personality disorder, often given to violence.

clue.text: Stayed well away from work

parts.note: kept off the job while in fact healthy, by feigning illness

explanation.surface: Kept a good distance from the workplace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' reads as 'far', but it means in good health: someone stayed off sick while not ill.
explanation.definitionFit: To shirk work by pretending to be ill is to feign sickness, though fit.

clue.text: Stock answer given by Solomon in classic dilemma

definitions.meaning: a new offering of company shares

definitions.text: answer given by Solomon in classic dilemma
definitions.meaning: read as 'share is issue': King Solomon offered to divide the disputed baby, the child being issue

explanation.surface: A standard reply credited to the wise king in a famous judgement.
explanation.walkthrough: Solomon settled two women's claim to a baby by proposing to cut it in two; issue means offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: Shares newly put on the market by a company are a release of stock.

clue.text: Fair in the marketplace

definitions.meaning: honest, ... dealing
an open town plaza where markets are held

explanation.surface: A fair being held in the town's market area.
explanation.definitionFit: A square deal is a fair one, and a town square is an open public place for markets.

clue.text: Head teachers

definitions.meaning: slang for the head
the National Union of Teachers, a British trade union

explanation.surface: A headteacher among the staff.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUT was the main teachers' union in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Nut is slang for the head, and the initials of the British teachers' union.

clue.text: Pennant flown by vessel with monarch aboard

indicators.note: on board a vessel, so inside it

parts.note: a steamer is a steamship
R for rex or regina, king or queen

explanation.surface: A flag flies from the ship while the king is on board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aboard' puts R inside STEAMER.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamer is a long narrow flag, like a pennant.

clue.text: Greek letter, precious if duplicated

definitions.meaning: the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet
written twice it makes a word for affectedly refined or twee

explanation.surface: A Greek letter that becomes affected when repeated.
explanation.walkthrough: Doubled it gives chichi, meaning showy or affectedly fancy.
explanation.definitionFit: Chi is the Greek letter written like an X, coming after phi.

clue.text: Warmer in the main

parts.note: main is the sea, so this is something heating the ocean: a warm Atlantic current

explanation.surface: Things are generally getting warmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the main' reads as 'mostly', but the main is the high sea.
explanation.definitionFit: This Atlantic current carries warm water to western Europe, making it a warmer of the sea.

clue.text: An explosion due to the cold

definitions.text: An explosion due to the cold

parts.words: An explosion due to the cold
parts.note: a sudden burst of breath caused by having a head cold

explanation.surface: Something blew up because of the freezing weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cold' reads as weather, but it is the illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden involuntary expulsion of air through the nose is a typical symptom of a cold.

clue.text: Erring dog ran off and played in the streets

definitions.note: a verb phrase standing for a noun: one who played in the streets

indicators.note: off means wrong or awry, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A stray dog ran away while music was played in the street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges ERRING DOG RAN. The definition implies 'one who', a loose Rufus touch.
explanation.definitionFit: A street musician cranking a barrel organ played for passers-by in town streets.

clue.text: Things of no value to students in their union

indicators.note: the students placed inside their union

parts.note: NUS is the National Union of Students in Britain
L is a learner, so two L's are students

explanation.surface: Worthless items handed to students in their union bar.
explanation.walkthrough: L for learner is the convention from British learner-driver plates, so two of them stand for students.
explanation.definitionFit: Nulls are zeros or things having no worth or effect.

clue.text: Speed of flier

definitions.meaning: a nautical mile per hour, used at sea and in the air
a wading bird of the sandpiper family

explanation.surface: How fast a bird or pilot is moving.
explanation.definitionFit: A knot is a unit of speed, and also a small shore bird.

clue.text: Nutcracker?

parts.note: nut being slang for head, a weapon to crack heads: a short heavy bludgeon

explanation.walkthrough: 'Nutcracker' reads as the kitchen tool, but nut is slang for head.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosh is a blunt weapon used to hit people over the head.

clue.text: Something like a rush on silver is accepted

indicators.note: the second piece goes on, after, the first

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a reed is a plant like a rush

explanation.surface: A run on silver is approved.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreed means consented to or accepted by all parties.

clue.text: Colour sergeant seen in Spanish dance

parts.note: flame is a bright reddish-orange shade
a sergeant is a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: A colour sergeant spotted at a Spanish dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Colour sergeant' looks like one army rank, but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco is the passionate Andalusian dance style.

clue.text: Acted evasively, being naturally guarded

definitions.meaning: avoided committing oneself
fenced by living bushes rather than walls

explanation.surface: Someone shuffling round questions because they are cautious by nature.
explanation.definitionFit: To hedge is to avoid giving a direct answer, and a field enclosed by bushes is hedged.

clue.text: Eke out the porridge

definitions.meaning: to make something last longer
British slang for time served in prison

explanation.surface: Making the oatmeal go further.
explanation.walkthrough: Porridge is British slang for a prison sentence, as is a stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: To stretch supplies is to eke them out, and a stretch is a prison term.
